scope: Conservative original-triangle bounds rejection before unchanged VTK exact collision; not new geometry, physics, navigation or measured speedup
contract: Inherit unchanged v5 ground-ID mask and immutable-owner guards. Candidate cap precedes extraction and all filters.
Read original VTK points, polygon offsets and connectivity through zero-copy read-only NumPy views. Bind exact array owners and modification times; never edit geometry.
Process at most 32,768 non-ground triangles per chunk; validate each original cell as three connected finite vertices.
Compute affine box-local vertex coordinates from the inverse reference box edge matrix. Reject only if all three vertices lie beyond the same padded local axis boundary.
Preserve original order and duplicates among survivors, and retain every exact VTK intersection, contained-vertex test, first-contact record and non-ground contact count.
Ill-conditioned or tiny-volume affine boxes retain every candidate for exact testing instead of hiding numerical errors with broad rejection.

Ground metrics remain None. candidateTriangles still counts all broadphase candidates. skippedGroundCandidateCount and rejectedNonGroundBoundsCandidates are distinct from exactNonGroundTriangleTests and from contacts.

tolerance.referencePadding: (1e-6 + 1e-5) * sum(reference box edge lengths) + 256 * float64 epsilon * coordinate scale
tolerance.parametricPadding: reference padding multiplied by each inverse edge-matrix row L1 norm
tolerance.scope: Affine box enclosures only; not a general warped-hexahedron bound
